scope: Standard and shuffle, weighted/unweighted, counts2/3/7, avoid0/1/count-1/count/count+3. Every selected index and RNG state match native across repeated resets. Native positive-weight fixture accessors; native history and RNG execute unchanged.
limits: Positive weights only, count2..65535, sum<=u32MAX accepted. Zero weights and single-entry fast path explicitly unsupported.
Runtime seeding, flag mapping, owner/global state and action probability not integrated. Existing Selector still used separately; new Playlist is not audible playback.
Standalone module tests only; full normal client not rebuilt.
